threshold.boundary: This is a source-backed structural pressure indicator, not a recognized ecological threshold.

extent.boundary: Circumpolar shipping extent within the IMO Polar Code area, not the full world ocean.

transformations.formula: Normalize the 2025 unique-ship count without double-counting repeat entries.
Use the documented crude-oil-tanker growth only for the non-direct threshold component; do not describe it as a recognized threshold.
Normalize the source-reported 2013–2025 increase in aggregate nautical miles sailed.
Retain a bounded circumpolar extent for the IMO Polar Code area.

receipts.uncertainty: Cable-system and fault totals are rounded global infrastructure statistics, and a cable fault is not necessarily a service outage at a landing point. Arctic ship counts cover the IMO Polar Code area; unique ships, aggregate distance and ship-type growth are retained as separate measures.
receipts.freshness: Arctic Council PAME observation through 2025; snapshot captured 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: Current 2025 ship magnitude, source-reported 12-year distance momentum and circumpolar extent provide 70% direct component coverage; a quantitative structural pressure indicator fills the remainder.
